name: Imose Eri
source:
Characteristics: Aggressive, willing to try anything. She is easily overworked. His weak points are his fingertips on her legs and arms (she's sensitive). She has a habit of biting.
Special ability: good luck charms.

On the outside, she is childish, shy, and cute.
Inside, she is mature and cunning.
She can also be more firm and mature than her two older sisters.
But on the flip side, she has a "I want everyone to be on good terms" feeling, and is also the result of her childishness and desire to be spoiled, which is appropriate for her age.
In fact, she is a lonely and fearful person. But she also loves the occult and likes ghosts and scary stories.

[Translated from [url=http://lovebitch.jp/imoto-tokku/index.html]Official Website[/url]]
